description: Unit test class NullAttributesTest for the NullAttributes class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON representation, and type checks on NullAttributes instances.

classes.name: NullAttributesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for NullAttributes, testing immutability, equality, JSON output, and type checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the NullAttributes instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that NullAttributes is immutable and that JsonObject is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode() and equals() methods of NullAttributes.

methods.name: nullAttributesIsJsonNull
methods.description: Checks that NullAttributes reports itself as null JSON.

methods.name: nullAttributesIsJsonObject
methods.description: Checks that NullAttributes reports itself as a JSON object.

methods.name: nullAttributesIsNothing
methods.description: Verifies that NullAttributes is not boolean, number, string, or array.
